name: pushery/sqlens-for-laravel
description: SQLens — database safety toolkit for Laravel. It lints pending migrations for lock and downtime risk and audits the live schema, on PostgreSQL and MySQL.

suggest.laravel/mcp: Serves the SQLens MCP server over stdio, so an agent can call the read-only tools directly. Without it `sqlens:mcp` reports a named undetermined and prints the install command rather than failing.
suggest.symfony/var-dumper: While `sqlens:mcp` runs, a forgotten dump goes to standard error instead of into the protocol stream. Used only where an application already has the dumper; without it there is no dump to divert, and nothing needs to be installed.
suggest.ext-pcntl: Lets `sqlens:mcp` finish the frame it is writing when it receives SIGTERM or SIGINT. Without it the server says so on standard error and stops abruptly instead; a session that the client ends is unaffected.
suggest.ext-pdo_pgsql: Needed to audit a PostgreSQL connection, as Laravel's pgsql driver needs it too. An application on MySQL alone does without it.
